title: MorphGNT: SBLGNT Edition (SBL Greek New Testament + morphological parsing & lemmas)
attribution: SBL Greek New Testament (Michael W. Holmes, Society of Biblical Literature / Logos, CC BY 4.0 / SBLGNT EULA); morphological parsing and lemmatization by J. K. Tauber and contributors (MorphGNT, CC BY-SA 3.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.376200).
notes: Default Greek NT spine (replaces raw diplomatic ntvmr-vaticanus-b). Checksum pins 61-Mt-morphgnt.txt at commit aaed91e57c8e4a8dc9a2383e129ca5e75fe6393d; all 27 NT book files are cloned/fetched at that immutable git SHA during thomas setup. Provides polytonic Koine surfaces, dictionary lemmas, and 8-slot morphological parses across all 27 NT books (~7,950 verses). Derived mapping models carry ShareAlike.
editor: Michael W. Holmes (SBLGNT); J. K. Tauber (MorphGNT)
